title: Phase 4: Cross-PDS Authentication
description:
## Goal
Enable secure cross-PDS authentication following ATProto specification using DID-based cryptographic verification (not callback-based verification).

## Research Findings

Based on official ATProto spec and Bluesky implementation:

**Service Auth (PDS-to-PDS):**
- Short-lived JWTs (<60 seconds) signed with user's atproto signing key
- DID-based verification: resolve DID → fetch signing key → verify signature
- No callback to origin PDS (purely cryptographic)
- Claims: iss (user DID), aud (service DID), exp, lxm (endpoint), jti (nonce)

**Client Auth (User-to-PDS):**
- OAuth 2.0 with DPoP (Demonstrating Proof of Possession)
- DPoP mandatory: binds tokens to specific devices
- Entryway acts as OAuth Authorization Server (large deployments)

## Revised Tasks

### Task 4.1: Service Auth JWT Creation (Outbound)
**Purpose:** When this PDS makes requests to other services on behalf of users

- [ ] Create ServiceAuthenticator in src/federation/service_auth.rs
- [ ] Implement create_service_jwt(user_did, target_service_did, endpoint)
- [ ] Fetch user's atproto signing key from DID document
- [ ] Sign JWT with user's key (ES256 algorithm)
- [ ] Set proper claims: iss, aud, exp (<60s), lxm, jti
- [ ] Generate unique nonce (jti) for replay protection
- [ ] Add error handling for key resolution failures
- [ ] Write unit tests

**Files:** src/federation/service_auth.rs (new)

### Task 4.2: Service Auth JWT Verification (Inbound)
**Purpose:** When this PDS receives requests from other PDSs

- [ ] Implement verify_service_jwt(token, expected_audience)
- [ ] Extract iss (issuer DID) from JWT
- [ ] Resolve DID document using IdentityResolver
- [ ] Fetch atproto signing key from DID document
- [ ] Verify JWT signature cryptographically
- [ ] Validate audience matches this PDS's DID
- [ ] Check expiration (strict <60s enforcement)
- [ ] Track jti nonces to prevent replay attacks
- [ ] Add comprehensive error handling
- [ ] Write verification tests

**Files:** src/federation/service_auth.rs

### Task 4.3: Extend IdentityResolver for Signing Keys
**Purpose:** Support fetching signing keys from DID documents

- [ ] Add get_signing_key(did) method to IdentityResolver
- [ ] Parse DID document verificationMethod section
- [ ] Extract atproto signing key (ES256 key)
- [ ] Cache signing keys with appropriate TTL (1 hour)
- [ ] Handle DID resolution failures gracefully
- [ ] Add invalidate_signing_key(did) method
- [ ] Write tests for key extraction

**Files:** src/identity/resolver.rs, src/identity/mod.rs

### Task 4.4: Add Service Auth Middleware
**Purpose:** Protect API routes with service auth verification

- [ ] Create service_auth_middleware in api/middleware.rs
- [ ] Extract Bearer token from Authorization header
- [ ] Call verify_service_jwt with this PDS's DID as audience
- [ ] Create ServiceAuthContext extractor with user DID
- [ ] Add to rate_limiter (stricter limits for cross-PDS)
- [ ] Fall back to local auth if no service token present
- [ ] Add audit logging for all cross-PDS requests
- [ ] Write middleware tests

**Files:** src/api/middleware.rs

### Task 4.5: DPoP Support (Client-to-PDS)
**Purpose:** Bind client access tokens to specific devices (ATProto requirement)

- [ ] Add DPoP proof verification to token validation
- [ ] Implement verify_dpop_proof(dpop_header, access_token)
- [ ] Validate DPoP-Nonce from server
- [ ] Track nonces to prevent replay
- [ ] Verify proof signature (ES256)
- [ ] Bind access token to DPoP public key
- [ ] Add dpop_nonce generation endpoint
- [ ] Write DPoP tests

**Files:** src/auth/dpop.rs (new), src/api/server.rs

### Task 4.6: Update API Routes for Cross-PDS Access
**Purpose:** Enable federated users to interact with this PDS

- [ ] Update repo.rs endpoints to accept ServiceAuthContext
- [ ] Modify create_record for cross-PDS users
- [ ] Modify put_record for cross-PDS users  
- [ ] Modify delete_record for cross-PDS users
- [ ] Add authorization checks (user owns resource or has permission)
- [ ] Ensure proper scope enforcement
- [ ] Write integration tests with mock cross-PDS requests

**Files:** src/api/repo.rs, src/api/blob.rs

### Task 4.7: Nonce Tracking & Replay Prevention
**Purpose:** Prevent replay attacks on service auth JWTs

- [ ] Create NonceStore in src/federation/nonce_store.rs
- [ ] Store jti nonces with expiration (60 seconds)
- [ ] Implement check_and_record_nonce(jti)
- [ ] Use in-memory cache (HashMap + RwLock) or database
- [ ] Add cleanup job for expired nonces
- [ ] Write replay attack tests

**Files:** src/federation/nonce_store.rs (new), src/jobs/tasks.rs

### Task 4.8: Security Hardening & Audit
**Purpose:** Ensure secure implementation

- [ ] Rate limiting: 10x stricter for cross-PDS requests
- [ ] Audit logging: Log all cross-PDS actions with DID, endpoint, result
- [ ] Strict expiration enforcement (<60 seconds, no grace period)
- [ ] Validate audience claim matches this PDS's DID exactly
- [ ] Add monitoring metrics for auth failures
- [ ] Security review of JWT verification logic
- [ ] Penetration testing (replay attacks, token forgery)
- [ ] Document security considerations

**Files:** src/metrics.rs, SECURITY.md (new)

## Security Checklist
- [ ] JWT signatures verified cryptographically (not via callback)
- [ ] DID documents resolved and keys fetched securely
- [ ] Nonce tracking prevents replay attacks
- [ ] Expiration strictly enforced (<60 seconds)
- [ ] Audience validation prevents token misuse
- [ ] Rate limiting prevents abuse (10x stricter for federated)
- [ ] Audit logs capture all cross-PDS actions
- [ ] DPoP binds tokens to devices
- [ ] No trust allowlist needed (cryptographic trust)

## Testing Checklist
- [ ] Local auth still works (no regression)
- [ ] Service auth JWT creation works
- [ ] Service auth JWT verification works
- [ ] Invalid signatures rejected
- [ ] Expired tokens rejected (<60s)
- [ ] Wrong audience rejected
- [ ] Replay attacks prevented (jti nonce)
- [ ] DPoP proof verification works
- [ ] Rate limiting works for cross-PDS
- [ ] Audit logs generated correctly
- [ ] End-to-end cross-PDS interaction test (2 PDS instances)

## Deliverables
- ServiceAuthenticator with JWT creation/verification
- Extended IdentityResolver with signing key support
- Service auth middleware
- DPoP support implementation
- NonceStore for replay prevention
- Updated API routes supporting cross-PDS access
- Security audit report
- Integration tests with 2 PDSs
- Updated documentation (FEDERATION.md, SECURITY.md)

## Duration
**3-4 weeks** (increased from 2 weeks due to DPoP and proper crypto implementation)

## Complexity
**High** (security-critical, cryptographic verification, ATProto compliance)

## Dependencies
- Phase 1 (Core Federation Infrastructure) ✅ Complete
- Phase 2 (Federated Search) ✅ Complete
- Phase 3 (Relay Firehose) ✅ Complete

## Key Changes from Original Plan

**❌ Wrong Approach (Original):**
- Token verification via callback to origin PDS
- Trust allowlist (only accept from known PDSs)

**✅ Correct Approach (ATProto Spec):**
- DID-based cryptographic verification (no callback)
- Trust via cryptography (verify JWT signature with DID's signing key)
- DPoP for client-to-PDS binding
- Short-lived tokens (<60 seconds)
- Nonce-based replay prevention

## References
- ATProto XRPC Spec: https://atproto.com/specs/xrpc
- Service Auth: https://docs.bsky.app/docs/advanced-guides/service-auth
- OAuth DPoP: https://atproto.com/specs/oauth
- DID Spec: https://atproto.com/specs/did
